Name: Always Organize Chests
Author: Zamiell
Description:
This mod automatically clicks on the "Organize Chest" button whenever a new item is put into a chest. This is a quality of life feature for those of us who compulsively click on the button manually all the time.

The source code for this mod is [url=https://github.com/Zamiell/stardew-valley-mods/tree/main/AlwaysOrganizeChests]available on GitHub[/url].

Manifest.Name: Always Organize Chests
Manifest.Description: Automatically organizes chests once their contents change
